summary.title: Flutter & Node JS Master Class: Amazon Clone with Admin Panel
summary.one_liner: A video walkthrough of building an Amazon-style Flutter shopping app with a Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend, including an admin panel.
keywords: user sign up sign in flutter
how to connect flutter to node backend
takeaways: How to set up a Flutter project with themes, folder structure and routes
How to build a Node.js and Express server with REST APIs and middleware
How to connect a Node backend to MongoDB using Mongoose models
How to wire Flutter screens to backend routes for sign up, sign in, cart, orders and admin features
summary.summary: This is a long (about 11.5 hour) video tutorial that builds an Amazon-style shopping app in Flutter with a Node.js, Express, MongoDB and Mongoose backend. The chapter list covers the Flutter client (themes, routing, auth screens, bottom navigation, product, cart, address and order screens) and the server side (Node basics, creating APIs, middleware, user model, sign up and sign in routes). It also includes an admin panel for adding and deleting products, viewing and updating orders, and showing earnings and a sales chart. The video ends with deployment to Heroku and testing on an Android device. The page is a YouTube listing, so the details come from the chapter titles only.
